entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • "dotnet package update" modifies wrong project file (csproj) #51012
  • `dotnet dev-certs` link doesn't seem relevent #51010
  • `dnx --help` suggests use of a package that is not a .NET SDK Tool #51008
  • Directory name with quotes confuse dotnet #51007
  • [NETSDKE2E][intermittent][Wix V5] Sometimes, .NET will be removed if upgrade .NET 10 RC1 to .NET 10.0.100-rc.2.25474.116 with registry key RemovePreviousVersion's value is 'nextSession' #51003

Closed

  • GenerateBundle Task fails writing to singlefilehost.exe #50784
  • Microsoft.NET.Publish.Tests.PublishItemsOutputGroupOutputsTests.RunPublishItemsOutputGroupOutputsTest fails for single-file win-x86 publishing #49926
  • Microsoft.NET.Publish.Tests.GivenThatWeWantToPublishIncrementally.It_cleans_between_renames fails in CI #50993
  • dotnet build for .net 4.7 library fails citing missing references #8931
    Discussion
  • [WebToolsE2E] The default solution file format created in CMD is 'sln'. #50953
  • Misleading error message when running dotnet new #12522

PullRequests

Created

  • Add warnings for newer tool versions during `dotnet tool restore` #51011
  • Fix `dnx --help` and tool commands to use valid .NET tool examples #51009
  • Enable hot reloading for Blazor inside an iframe #51006
  • Allow SDKs to overwrite default file-based app properties #51004
    Area-run-file
  • [release/10.0.1xx-rc2] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50999
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50998
    Area-CodeFlow

Merged

  • Allow charset to be `unset` #42266
    untriaged, Area-Format
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Allow charset to be `unset` #50963

Updated

  • Update analyzer redirecting VS extension #50496
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Improve where file-level directives are added #50956
    Area-run-file
  • Manual backport of 48874 to release 9.0.3xx #50940
    Servicing-consider, needs team triage, Partner request, Area-dotnet new, Branch Lockdown
  • Notify DCP of terminated session when process exits on its own #50992
    Area-AspNetCore
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50946
  • dotnet SIGTERM signal handler registration #50983
    Area-CLI
  • Misc Json PostAction fixes #50977
  • [WIP] [do not review] enable containerd tests #49617
    Area-Infrastructure
  • dotnet test for MTP: localize test summary + update command description #50975
